sample_unit: patients (20 head and neck, 20 thoracic, 19 male pelvis)
models_evaluated: Six AI auto-segmentation vendors (unnamed, models as of March 2023)

links.outcome: Performance of six competing auto-segmentation vendors compared on the same patient data
links.effect: Vendors varied widely from excellent to poor on raw performance metrics (Dice, Hausdorff Distance, Average Surface Distance, Surface Dice, Added Path Length); no vendor performed exceedingly well overall.
links.quote: In terms of raw performance, vendors varied widely from excellent to poor.

unlisted_practices: Structured multi-category vendor selection criteria framework (47 criteria across seven categories) for AI auto-segmentation
Geometric contour-overlap metrics (Dice, Hausdorff, surface distance, added path length) to compare auto-segmentation vendors

screen.reason: Empirically tests and applies a holistic 47-criteria evaluation framework covering security, ethics, and performance across six commercial AI auto-segmentation vendors on clinical datasets.

primary.practice: multidimensional vendor selection and evaluation framework
